scripts.local: npm run unquarantine && npm run generate_thumbs_grid && npm run generate_pages && PATH="$HOME/.gem/ruby/2.6.0/bin:$PATH" BUNDLE_GEMFILE=Gemfile.local bundle exec jekyll serve --trace
scripts.deploy: git add . && git commit -m "deploying Jekyll site! on $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" && git push
scripts.download_and_deploy: npm run download && npm run generate_thumbs && npm run generate_thumbs_grid && npm run generate_pages && npm run deploy
scripts.build: npm run generate_thumbs_grid && npm run generate_pages && PATH="$HOME/.gem/ruby/2.6.0/bin:$PATH" BUNDLE_GEMFILE=Gemfile.local bundle exec jekyll build
